title: Sound & Tones
description: Three playable keyboards that make tones through the cassette port, dated 10-14-82.
versionOrder: Disk saves have no recorded order or dates beyond their source comments. Any ordering here is a presentation guess.

versions.label: Sound & Tones (blocks 80-84)
versions.note: Source blocks copied unchanged from the New Programs disk. The player boots the Forth System disk and loads them with the original commands. Checked to its first screen only.
versions.startupSource:
==== Block 80 ====
 0 ( 10-14-82  SOUND  & TONES    PAGE  1 OF 5 )  : TASK ;
 1 
 2 : PAUSE 0 DO LOOP ; ( DELAY COUNT FROM STACK )
 3 
 4   CODE :DI DI NEXT    CODE :EI EI  NEXT
 5 
 6 : KEYTONE (  CYLCLES FROM STACK ) DUP 100 < *  14398 @ IF
 7     :DI    BEGIN  1  255  OUTP    DUP PAUSE
 8     2 255 OUTP  DUP PAUSE
 9                  14398 @ 0=  UNTIL  DROP :EI  THEN  ;
10 : OLDBOARD  BEGIN KEY DUP  DUP 96 < IF  64 -  ELSE 69  - THEN
versions.running: Running MMSFORTH from the original disks

attribution.text: From a 1982 MMSFORTH disk; the source names no author. Runs on MMSFORTH V2.0, © 1981 Miller Microcomputer Services. Preserved here for small-scale archival use.

howTo: Click the screen, then type KEYBOARD and press Enter for a piano-like keyboard, OLDBOARD for the one used for demos, or DELTABOARD for an experimental one. Then play on the letter keys. Sound comes from the emulated cassette port.
quickHelp: Type KEYBOARD, OLDBOARD, or DELTABOARD, then Enter. Letters play notes.
